lines.x: There is no need to be overly concerned about my condition. I will adapt to these slight changes in my physiology soon enough, and they will not interfere with my work. From here on, I will continue to serve as your general practitioner.

The sarcophagus's core apparatus is what sustains my life at present; I cannot move far from it for some time yet. Treating my own vital state with caution is an experience I have never had before. There is much I must grow familiar with all over again. Perhaps this time, too, I will need your guidance.

In the most critical hour, you led Rhodes Island to its heading. Amiya is without question a mature leader now, and I have never once doubted Closure's talent or your decisions. Rhodes Island will not be unable to move forward simply because someone has left. Everything we lost shaped the Rhodes Island that stands today as well.

I am glad Mon3tr has found her way into Rhodes Island like this. She has no others of her kind, but fortunately there are many here who regard her as a comrade. She will not forget the mission we bore together—you may trust her completely. In the time to come, she will stay by your side far longer than I will.

Priestess no longer threatens Rhodes Island's safety, for the time being. She has left the choice to you. The Originium anomaly has torn open the old wounds these lands kept hidden; if left unguided, despair may well destroy us before the disaster does. In every age, civilization's greatest enemy is humanity itself.

Do you still lose your way, as you are now? The only fulcrum that lets anyone search for their own meaning is the nature of life itself—though for me it was a mission, a promise. I no longer question the meaning of my existence. At the end of the journey, the individual called Kal'tsit has found herself.

Those partings can neither be made peace with nor undone. I never expected to be granted another life, either. I count myself fortunate, and I am grateful. To me it was little more than a dream, but the wait must have been agonizing for all of you. I'm sorry... You're right. A parting like that isn't fair.

Nothing constrains our conversations any longer; I have no secrets left from the person you are now. I would gladly share with you what I witnessed across ten thousand years, though I fear the thoughts and feelings themselves are beyond words. Very well. Before these memories fade, I will tell you as much as I can.

I will never forget that someone once spoke with me of life and love. At last, within the limited time this body is given, I can answer. I will patiently accept what time wears away, and I will carry out the oath I swore—until, next time, it is true death that parts us.
Thankfully... this is not another dream.
Dr.{@nickname}......？
The situation ahead will only grow more severe. We would do well to learn from experience.
You have many comrades you can trust now. As a leader, you should grow accustomed to letting them become your strength.
You no longer need my guidance, and from here on, Rhodes Island and these lands will need you all the more. Do not forget the proposition you began with—'Find yourself.'
I can take part in drawing up the emergency care plan.
No problem.
Mon3tr, there's no need to worry. You had better stay here and protect the Doctor.
Do everything possible to reduce casualties. We must preserve as much hope for Terra as we can.
Treatment preparations complete.
I trust you.
Global treatment unit deployed.
Carry out the plan without concern. I will see to the Operators' safety.
Ark organism protocol, initiated.
Command: Repair.
Mon3tr, I need you to protect the wounded.
Do not be afraid. This power will only ever be used to heal.
Perhaps we will live to see that future that belongs to everyone.
No casualties.
The battlefield is growing complex. Variables outside the plan cannot be avoided, but there are always means of correction.
Get the others out first. Mon3tr, I need your help with the cleanup.
Just as it always was.
There is no need to check on my condition so often. This body is no different from anyone else's.
If it truly weighs on you—I am quite well right now.
Arknights.

This holiday has come around again. At last I can feel time passing through me. It is not frightening—time is precious because it is finite, and perhaps an experience like this is closer to an ordinary life. Doctor, I wish you peace and good health in the new year.
Doctor. I'm here.

Time has already erased every trace of the world you originally belonged to; even the calendar that counted its lives is gone. So I would rather offer you my blessing in the manner of these lands. I hope I can make you believe that, however long and perilous your journey may be, you are never alone.

Rhodes Island's ideals have already brought many people together. After enduring untold misery and pain, there are still those who hope for the future. Whether or not we can cross all this suffering, the vision Rhodes Island carries has always belonged to the whole of Terra—and it deserves to be remembered.
